title: Comunicado 2025-02-06
summary: Banxico's Board cut the policy rate 50bp to 9.50%, stepping up from the 25bp pace of 2024 on the argument that, with the global inflation episode largely resolved and headline (3.69%) and core (3.72%) back near pre-pandemic averages, the restriction the shocks demanded is no longer needed. The guidance is explicitly dovish: the Board could keep calibrating and 'consider adjusting it by a similar magnitude', and expects the environment to allow the cutting cycle to continue, only qualified by keeping the stance restrictive. The case leans on a Q4 GDP contraction, a decelerating labor market and an activity risk balance tilted down, while the inflation risk balance stays tilted up and US tariff threats and peso volatility are flagged as two-sided risks. Jonathan Heath dissented for a 25bp cut, the one hawkish brake on an otherwise accelerating easing message. This is the first collegiate document of 2025 in the base, so there is no prior communique to compare against.

key_quotes.quote: Tomando en cuenta el actual panorama inflacionario y el grado de restricción monetaria prevaleciente, la Junta de Gobierno consideró apropiado una reducción de la tasa de referencia de mayor magnitud.
key_quotes.context: Rationale for accelerating to a 50bp cut

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno estima que hacia delante podría continuar con la calibración de la postura monetaria y considerar ajustarla en magnitud similar.
key_quotes.context: Guidance signalling further cuts of similar (50bp) size

key_quotes.quote: Prevé que el entorno inflacionario permita seguir con el ciclo de recortes a la tasa de referencia, si bien manteniendo una postura restrictiva.
key_quotes.context: Cutting cycle continues, while stance stays restrictive

key_quotes.quote: En el cuarto trimestre se acentuó la debilidad de la actividad económica nacional, al registrarse una contracción.
key_quotes.context: Activity weakness backing the larger move
